NLNK-M1.description: General Link (NLNK-M1). Connects two nodes with a general-link property; REF_SYSTEM chooses the reference coordinate system (0=Element uses BETA_ANGLE, 1=Global uses INPUT_METHOD to pick ANGLE_VALUES/POINT_VALUES/VECTOR_VALUES).

PROP_NAME.description: General Link Property name; must reference an existing general-link property (NLLP) or the request is rejected.

REF_SYSTEM.description: Reference coordinate system: 0 = Element (uses BETA_ANGLE), 1 = Global (uses INPUT_METHOD and the matching values array).

GROUP_NAME.description: Boundary Group name; must reference an existing boundary group when non-empty, otherwise the request is rejected. Empty string means no group.

BETA_ANGLE.description: [REF_SYSTEM=0] Beta angle in degrees for the Element reference coordinate system.

INPUT_METHOD.description: [REF_SYSTEM=1] Orientation input method for the Global reference system: 0 = Angle (ANGLE_VALUES), 1 = 3 Points (POINT_VALUES), 2 = Vector (VECTOR_VALUES).

ANGLE_VALUES.description: [REF_SYSTEM=1, INPUT_METHOD=0] Rotation angles. One object whose VALUE holds 3 numbers (x, y', z").

VALUE.description: Angle components [x, y', z"] in degrees; 3 values.

POINT_VALUES.description: [REF_SYSTEM=1, INPUT_METHOD=1] Three points P0, P1, P2. Three objects, each VALUE holding 3 numbers (X, Y, Z).

VALUE.description: Point coordinates [X, Y, Z]; 3 values per point.

VECTOR_VALUES.description: [REF_SYSTEM=1, INPUT_METHOD=2] Two direction vectors V1, V2. Two objects, each VALUE holding 3 numbers (X, Y, Z).

VALUE.description: Vector components [X, Y, Z]; 3 values per vector.
